claim: You can create more than one hosted zone with the same name and add different records to each. Route 53 assigns four name servers to every hosted zone, and by default the name servers differ for each one; with a reusable delegation set, created with the API, you can assign the same four name servers to several hosted zones.

evidence.quote: You can create more than one hosted zone with the same name and add different records to each. Route 53 assigns four name servers to every hosted zone, and the name servers differ for each one.
By default, Route 53 assigns a unique set of four name servers (called a delegation set) to each hosted zone that you create.
You can then create hosted zones with the API and assign the same four name servers to each one.
